question: Which genre had the most content views in Q2 2026 (April to June)?

name: run_sql
purpose: Count Q2 2026 view-event rows by catalog genre, with view-type and distinct-viewer checks, to identify the genre with the most views.
query: SELECT c.genre, COUNT(*) AS content_views, COUNT(DISTINCT v.user_id) AS unique_viewers, MIN(v.date) AS first_view_date, MAX(v.date) AS last_view_date, SUM(CASE WHEN v.view_type='free' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS free_views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.view_type='sub' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sub_views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.view_type='ppv' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ppv_views FROM content_views v JOIN content_catalog c ON c.content_id=v.content_id WHERE v.date >= '2026-04-01' AND v.date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c.genre ORDER BY content_views DESC

answer:
## Answer
**Isekai** had the most content views in Q2 2026, with **57,997**—**4,133 more** than fantasy, the runner-up.

## Definition and scope
Counted view-event rows from April 1 through June 30, 2026, grouped by the genre of the viewed title.

## Data quality
Matched view events to the content catalog by content ID. The genre results covered the full Q2 date range.
